# Value

Gives you one number to share between connected settings.

`lfs.value` · Input

## How to use

Connect Value to several numeric inputs to control them together.  
Start at 0 and drag the number to adjust it.  

## Inputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Value | `Value` | lfs.float | 0 | step 0.01 | Shared number. 0 is the default; negative and positive numbers are allowed. |

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Value | `Value` | lfs.float | — | — | Resulting number, in the units of your calculation. Connect it to a compatible numeric input. |
